sources.title: Introduction to Information Retrieval
sources.verification: Author-hosted textbook pages accessed;raw term count and document-frequency principles. +1 smoothing and exact tokenizer are explicit local conventions.

sources.title: Speech and Language Processing,3rd edition draft
sources.verification: Author-hosted current draft/chapter index accessed;bounded local implementation declares add-k,UNK and EOS perplexity conventions.

sources.title: Distributed Representations of Words and Phrases and their Compositionality
sources.verification: Primary paper verified by independent embedding agent;SGNS and unigram^.75 noise. Fixed empirical negatives are declared variant.

sources.title: GloVe:Global Vectors for Word Representation
sources.verification: Primary ACL paper verified;positive-cell weighted least squares and vector/bias families.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.verification: Primary verified by Transformer agent;attention/residual/normalization/FFN. Token models here use declared compact frozen backbones.

sources.title: BERT:Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
sources.verification: Primary verified;bidirectional MLM semantics. Local always-MASK policy,no NSP/segment embeddings and head-only training explicitly differ.

sources.title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
sources.verification: Primary OpenAI report verified;autoregressive causal architecture. No pretrained weights or production equivalence.

sources.title: A Tutorial on Hidden Markov Models and Selected Applications in Speech Recognition
sources.verification: Author-hosted original tutorial accessible,no readable text parse claimed;existing approved B11 inference reused and independently enumerated.

sources.title: Conditional Random Fields:Probabilistic Models for Segmenting and Labeling Sequence Data
sources.verification: Original8-page paper verified by sequence agent;global conditional normalization/features/forward-backward. Dense linear feature baseline declared.

sources.title: Representing Text Chunks
sources.verification: Primary representation paper verified. Strict BIO feature-based CRF is one chosen NER task baseline.

sources.title: The CYK Algorithm
sources.verification: University-hosted teaching source accessed;CNF substring recurrence. Local grammar bounds,deterministic tree and epsilon policy declared.
